derivation_notes.dollar_volume: volume_fp / volume_24h_fp / open_interest_fp are fixed-point contract counts. Every market reports notional_value_dollars = 1.0000, so one contract carries exactly $1.00 of notional and a contract count is numerically equal to gross dollar notional. No price weighting is applied.
derivation_notes.traded_notional_dollars: Exact: SUM(yes_price_dollars * count_fp) over every trade returned by GET /markets/trades in the sampled window (3 pages x limit 1000). Only populated for tickers that appear in that window.
derivation_notes.ranking: events/markets sorted by volume_24h_fp desc, then volume_fp desc.
derivation_notes.topic_rules: Official Kalshi `category` / `tags` values, never free-text matching.
